name: Z8
summary: The A. O. Smith Z8 RO Water Purifier features 8-stage RO + Silver Charged Membrane Technology (SCMT) to deliver 100% RO purified, baby-safe drinking water .
intro: The A. O. Smith Z8 RO Water Purifier features advanced RO + Silver Charged Membrane Technology (SCMT)with an 8-stage purification process to deliver 100% RO purified, baby-safe drinking water. It offers instant warm (45°C) and hot (80°C) water, a digital display, Night Assist, and 5-Star Rated Advanced Recovery Technology™that saves up to 2X more water than conventional RO purifiers. Suitable for borewell, tanker, and mixed water sources, it can be installed as a wall-mounted or tabletop unit, making it a stylish and reliable choice for modern homes.
